title: Kenyan Vegetable Stew
description: A flavorful stew originating from Kenya, made with a variety of vegetables and a hint of resinous spices.
instructions: Bring the vegetable broth to a boil in a large pot.
Reduce heat to medium and add the thyme sprigs.
Peel and chop the sweet potatoes and carrots, and add them to the pot.
Simmer the stew for 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional thyme if desired.
